title: Writing clearly: structure, precision and economy of words

videos.script: An architect who cannot write ends up deciding very little. {{title}} The decisions still get made. They get made by whoever wrote the clearest page, and that page is read in thirty seconds, on a phone, between two meetings. {{phone}} This course follows one company, Marola, and one engineer there, Lívia. Most of her week is writing. A proposal, a reply to the finance director, a review comment, an update during an incident. {{marola}} This lesson is about the sentences themselves. Who reads them and what they do next. Putting the answer before the story of how you found it. {{pyramid}} Replacing words like soon and slow with something a reader could check. And cutting everything that carries nothing. {{cut}} At the end there is a way of editing a page in six passes. It takes about as long as writing the draft did, and it is the part that gets read.
